tail:
Group `d` step-3 review complete. Verdicts written to `research/frontier-18-alpha-d-step3-verdicts.json`; reasoning in `research/frontier-18-alpha-d-step3-scaffold-review.md`.

**All three pairs `sufficient`** — two of them after repairs I made rather than routed, so nothing goes to `3-fix` from my group.

Three repairs applied to the manifests:

**B2-1 (fatal-class).** `prop-maximal-elementary-abelian-subgroups-distinguish-the-two-extraspecial-two-groups` had a route that did not close and a Statement finer than the route delivered: it exhibited one subgroup of order $2^{n+1}$ and bounded above (giving a *maximum* order), while van Beek 2.39(ii) — the harvested source — is about every subgroup maximal under inclusion. Its plus-type bound also re-derived, by an unlicensed "centraliser is too small" step, what item 26 already gives in a line, and its minus-type argument did not close as written. I inserted the two items the route needs — `def-square-map-of-an-extraspecial-two-group` and `lem-the-square-map-is-well-defined-and-refines-the-commutator-pairing`, both two lines from the class-two power formula already on the page — and rewrote the strategy as a coset count against the existing involution count, which yields $2^{k}-2^{2n-k-1}=\pm2^{n-1}$ with a strictly increasing left side, hence $k=n$ and $k=n-1$ uniquely. That partly overturns Beta's Finding 3: the Arf invariant stays declined (no harvest row in either source; the theory sits at order 92), but the design's quadratic-form items 13–14 were not part of that block and are restored.

**B2-12.** `splice-plan --batch 2` was refusing on a `requires` disagreement the step-0 drift review created by running after the Betas. Aligned the manifest to the spec; splice now clean.

**B9-1/B9-2.** `thm-a-set-weighted-limit-is-a-limit-over-a-category-of-elements` carried only the limit clause while two Riehl coverage rows, (7.1.8) and (7.2.4), both name it — a gap visible only by reading manifest and harvest together. Added the colimit clause, and added the existence corollary the weighted half lacked while the ends half had one.

**Cayley split declined.** Beta recommended it and I verified the cut is clean (no edge from the first thirty items into the last thirty). But 60 is not over 60, two published pages already sit at 60, and executing the split on this run would trip `batch-a-pair-cap` and force a `manifest-integrity --write-ledger --force` re-baseline. Recorded instead: no A item may be added to that page after step 4, and the split is recommended to the owner for `frontier-19` planning, where all four consumers are still unbuilt.

Gates after the edits: content-policy 202 items 0 errors, coverage-checklist 331 results 0 errors, both splices clean, `validate-plan` on a spliced copy clean at 48/60/50 items. All 174 external dependencies published, none `ai-generated`, none legacy-unclassified.

One doc bug for whoever next touches it: `SCHEMA.md` §6 still states a 100-item A-page ceiling; the code and `CLAUDE.md` say 60.
